mods.name: Beat FX Tab
mods.author: b.sr
mods.summary: Keep the Beat FX panel closed and still see it all: effect, beat value, channel and on/off, in one small label.
mods.description:
New in 1.1: colours matched to the deck's stock theme, a channel row (CH SELECT), TIME in a grey box while you turn the TIME knob, and fixes: the label no longer vanishes after a CH SELECT press.

Keep the BEAT FX panel closed and get your screen space back. On the 2 DECK waveform views, the collapsed tab shows the effect, its beat value (REVERB: LENGTH %; X-PAD on the pad) and its channel (3 1 2 4, MST, MIC, A, B). Off: grey; on: lit in the effect's color. Tap it as usual to open the stock panel.

Display only: no hooks, files or network. Known issue: it stays on top of TRACK INFO.

mods.name: Nudge Indicator
mods.author: b.sr
mods.summary: Beatmatching by hand? See how many ms apart the two decks' beats are, and a green line when they are in phase.
mods.description:
For beatmatching by hand. On the 2 DECK waveform view, while decks 1 and 2 play at the same tempo, two small ticks and a number show how far apart their beats are, in milliseconds. The upper tick is deck 1, the lower one deck 2: right of it when deck 2 is behind, left when it is ahead. Nudge until they meet: within 5 ms they turn into one green line. It compares the tracks' beat grids, as Sync does, so it is only as accurate as their rekordbox analysis: where a grid is off, the line shows while the beats are audibly apart. Works with or without the core's Phase Meter. Display only: no hooks.

The lower tick moves 1 px per millisecond, up to 14 px; past that, read the number. The green line stays up to 5 ms and through a brief jump in the reading. The sign sits right of the deck's loop sign, between the two waveforms; with the Phase Meter on it moves left of the meter's rulers by itself. It hides while a deck is stopped, while the tempos differ (more than 0.2 % for 2 seconds), on the 4 DECK views and with themes on. It compares beats, not bars. The Status page in the Mod Menu shows live what the mod sees. No files, no network, and it never touches a button, a knob or the audio.
